title: Skeels Corners Slate
description: Laminated black slate with thin orange dolostone beds

title: Bascom Formation
description: Dolostone, limestone, and marble; interbedded light gray to weathered dark gray dolostone, limestone, and marble with thin beds of calcareous sandstone

title: Shelburne Marble
description: White, massively bedded, sucrosic marble with gray laminae

title: Clarendon Springs Formation
description: Dolostone: Mottled light to dark gray, massively bedded dolostone with chert clasts, disseminated quartz grains, vugs, and quartz knots

title: Danby Formation
description: Dolostone and sandstone: interbedded buff to white cross-bedded dolomitic sandstone and quartzite, and buff to gray dolostone

title: Winooski Dolostone
description: Buff to gray medium to massively bedded dolostone

title: Monkton Quartzite
description: Interbedded red sandstone, red shale, and buff dolostone; lower parts are gray to white sandstone with quartz pebble beds

title: Dunham Dolostone
description: Buff to light gray to white, thick-bedded dolostone and cyclically-bedded buff to pink dolostone

title: Cheshire Quartzite
description: White to buff, thin to thick-bedded quartzite with gray to brown argillaceous beds

title: Fairfield Pond Formation
description: Light-gray to light-green quartz-sericite-chlorite phyllite +/- magnetite and biotite

title: Underhill Formation, Phyllite and schist member
description: Silver green quartz-muscovite-chlorite schist and phyllite, commonly with albite and magnetite +/- dolomite. Local lenses of white to pale gray quartzite, quartz-albite granulite and quartz granule chlorite and/or biotite metawacke

title: Underhill Formation, Greenstone and Amphibolite member
description: Thinly bedded, carbonate-albite-epidote greenstone and massive magnetite-albite-amphibole-biotite-spidote amphibolite; light to dark green fine to medium-grained, epidote-chlorite-albite-amphibole schist; dark green, coarse-grained, weakly foliated epidote-biotite-albite-amphibole amphibolite

title: Pinnacle Formation, Metagraywacke, schist and phyllite member
description: Quartz is commonly blue; local thin conglomeratic horizons; feldspathic biotite metawacke interlayered with lenses of quartz, feldspar, and gneiss pebble to cobble conglomerate

title: Pinnacle Formation, Biotite metagraywacke member
description: Brown weathering, gray to dark gray, medium-coarse grained, massively bedded, chlorite-muscovite-biotite-feldspar-quartz metawacke with minor carbonate. Locally contains conglomeratic beds <1 m thick with well rounded quartz and gneiss pebbles (<5 cm), gray to green chloritic metawacke +/- biotite and chlorite-magnetite schist; local discontinuous pods of vein quartz and dolomitic interbeds

title: Pinnacle Formation, Schistose metagraywacke and phyllite member
description: Undifferentitated light gray, massive, medium-grained quartz-sericite+/- chlorite, albite, dolomite metagraywacke; fine grained, gray or green epidote-quartz-quartz-chlorite-sericite phyllite and schist

title: Pinnacle Formation, Undifferentiated volcanic and volcaniclastic rock member
Pinnacle Formation, Amphibolitic greenstone member
description: Calcite-biotite-sphene-albite-actinolite-epidote-chlorite greenstone +/- sericite, apatite, pyrite, and magnetite with dark green porphyroblasts of actinolitic hornblende

title: Pinnacle Formation, Calcareous greenstone member
description: Rusy weathering and pitted, dark green greenstone with laminae and splotches of calcareous material; locally interbedded with calcareous metagraywacke

title: Pinnacle Formation, Feldspathic greenstone member
description: Olive drab weathering, dark green, fine grained greenstone with remnant plagioclase feldspar phenocrysts up to 1.5 cm
